title: Test forms have bounded Euclidean coefficient norm
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set and let ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) (a TestFormOn U n: a smooth, compactly supported n-form on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ U). Then there is C ∈ ℝ with C > 0 such that |ω(x)| ≤ C for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : Eucl P, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C
